svg.title: Phase 4b: controller, operator and worker nodes
svg.desc: Thin clients submit jobs to the controller, which hands work to GPU nodes that read media and models from storage.

g.text: S3, GCS, Azure, SFTP via rclone
A client submits a job over gRPC.
A node with the required backend pulls it.
The node reads the media through rclone and loads the model.
Nodes pass (reference, distorted, score, metadata) triples to the sidecar.
The sidecar writes the updated .onnx to the registry.
